method: sum the best measured initialized steady-state GPU time for each sequential stage; exclude process startup, file I/O, most readback, cross-stage barriers, game contention, and any unmeasured boundary cost
interpretation: This is an optimistic lower bound, not a whole-game benchmark. It proves that eliminating per-frame JIT/process/file overhead is necessary but insufficient. Realtime requires large algorithm/kernel gains in several stages, especially block70, both 32-channel full-resolution stages, and ViT; addon integration alone cannot close the gap.
completion_gate: Do not claim realtime until the in-game addon shows consecutive changing frames at a stated measured cadence and the displayed output is visually validated.
